<thought>To obtain the precursors, I apply retrosynthetic template 1914391 to the product SMILES derived from the mapped reaction. The product SMILES (without atom‑mapping) is:
`CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC[C@H](O)C(C)C@@H(/C=C(C)C(=O)OC)O1`.
Applying the template yields the two reactants that were on the left side of the mapped reaction. These are:
1. The sugar‑derived fragment: `CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC[C@H](O)C(C)C@@H(C=O)O1`
2. The phosphonate alkyne fragment: `C[C@H](P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F)C#COC`

Thus the list of possible precursor combinations is:
`[['CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC[C@H](O)C(C)C@@H(C=O)O1', 'C[C@H](P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F)C#COC']]`.</final_answer>
